info.name: Travlr Module 7 Security
info.description: Module Seven authentication and protected CRUD endpoint tests for the Travlr Getaways application.

exec: pm.test('Registration succeeds or user already exists', function () { pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', body.token); }
pm.test('Cleanup is safe to repeat', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Unauthenticated POST is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
